title: Gem Swap
description: Swap neighbouring gems to line up three or more of the same colour. Chain reactions and big matches score extra — reach the target score before you run out of moves.
instructions: Drag or swipe a gem onto a neighbour to swap them.
Or click one gem, then click a neighbour.
Keyboard: arrows move, Space selects, then an arrow swaps.
Match 3 or more in a row or column.
